name: Kofi
self_text: I am a Mexican man in my mid 30s. Outside of photography, I enjoy baking sourdough because I love the process of creating something from scratch. I use a Leica. Honestly, I'm just looking for a practice session working on specific shots. I'm cool with taking portraits of each other. As for editing, I want someone to teach me post-processing. Fair warning, gear talk is fine but not the point is my thing. Most weeks I can do Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into either a relaxed photo walk or a practice session working on specific shots. It's a deal-breaker unless you are the one who teaches me post-processing. It would be nice if you are available Sunday afternoon, but no big deal.
